Era V · The Sin of the Wither
Perhaps some grieving Builder. Perhaps some Scourge villager lost to obsession —
He or she walked alone into an obsidian altar,
following the other way shown in the old tomes —
soul sand and 3 Wither skeleton skulls —
Three heads, six wings, bone and blue skin — born, it blew the altar to ruin.
It was no natural creature — it was made, in a forbidden experiment,
condensing the price of “defying life and death.”
The Wither killed the one who had tried it alone.
Then it began to kill everyone around.
